name: Ca
text: I took multiple sessions with Rupesh and have consistently been impressed by his deep expertise in DevOps and the AWS cloud domain. text: I had the opportunity to interview with Rupesh for the Senior Site Reliability Engineer role. name: Sairaj
text: It was great to work with Rupesh, learned new things about behavioral interview. It was a very detailed and informative session. He also shared lot of resources which are helpful for preparation.

name: Faiz

name: Faiz
text: Rupesh has been a great help and mentor for preparing for my interview. text: I really enjoyed my session with Rupesh. I found his feedback to be very direct, sincere, and helpful.

name: Abhishek
text: Rupesh is amazing! He has extensive knowledge in technology and really helped me think at a higher level. His coaching has given me a framework to answer questions with numbers and always aim to raise the bar. Highly recommend him.

name: Abhirup
text: Resume Review for Mid- to Senior Full-Stack Engineer - The session was well-timed and interactive. Also, he is friendly and positive, and gave some long-term career path guidance too.

name: Ann
text: This was my >2 times with Rupesh for mock interview! I had the opportunity to work with Rupesh to prepare for a panel session for a Solutions Architect role. Rupesh provided highly actionable feedback—he helped me improve the overall structure of the panel discussion, identify key focus areas, flag red flags. He holds a very high bar and treats each mock interview as seriously as if it were his own team's hiring process.

name: Ricardo
text: Rupesh is great! He provided me with more information in one hour than I could ever get in weeks of research. I now have a 6 month roadmap to data engineering. Look forward to keep working with him.

name: Ann
text: Another session with Rupesh to help prepare for the technical round – Rupesh quickly identified my strengths and weaknesses in a few data engineering areas and helped me structure my responses in a more professional way. His feedback was valuable and really helped me improve my approach.

name: Ann
text: I'm currently preparing for a Solutions Architect role with a data background. Rupesh started the session by proposing a clear structure, which helped set the tone for a productive conversation - definitely five stars. What I truly appreciated was his thoughtful and caring approach. He made sure I left the session with a clear framework and practical guidance.

name: Fernando
text: Rupesh is an exceptional professional who can provide me with all the necessary guidance to excel in my next interviews. Your view and tips surely will help me stand out in the crowd and be more prepared to prevent the common pitfalls during interviews.

name: Sina
text: I learned a lot from Rupesh. He gave me actionable feedback on how to better present my past experiences.

name: Melvin
text: Rupesh was amazing to work with. By the end of the session, I had a 90-day step-by-step plan to turn my career around.
